items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: That started romance. We went together. I got a son with her.

ctx.x: Shake side over the place. Well, when we get out there,

I was glad to see that. I asked her to play a few numbers for me. So I sat in the band, Tiki Long. I only had one trumpet then. And I played a few numbers, and they all liked it. And Emma kept looking at me, and she was like she fell in love with me. And I left for my dad. She called me up the next day. That started romance. We went together. I got a son with her. I'm 35 years old right now. I know.
Well, I met your son one time over in Piqu. Oh, yeah. Opened his place up on London that time, and you had your band up there. Your son was there.
